description: Structural contract for progress/work/<feature-name>.json, enforced by .agents/lib/workflow.py.

optional.claim: object: id, owner, revision. Absent in records created before claims existed.
optional.claim_history: array of reassigned or handoff-resumed events, each with the previous claim
optional.handoff: null, or object: id, path, kind, revision, from, sha256 of the immutable handoff file
optional.handoff_history: array of earlier handoff pointers, newest first
